scripts.text:
[Munster]
My family used to live in Geffen. So I guess it was natural that we studied forging and eventually became Blacksmiths. Then, we finally moved to this town,
Al De Baran.
scripts.translation:
[蒙斯特]
我家以前住在吉芬。所以我想我们学习锻造并最终成为铁匠是很自然的事情。后来，我们终于搬到了这个城镇，
艾尔帕兰。

scripts.text: About ^3355FFItem Upgrade^000000
scripts.translation: 关于 ^3355FF道具强化^000000

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Munster]
My father was a famous blacksmith in Geffen, and he taught me a lot about forging equipment.
scripts.translation:
[蒙斯特]
我父亲是吉芬著名的铁匠，他教了我很多关于装备锻造的知识。

scripts.text:
[Munster]
One of the fundamentals is that the success probability of upgrading an item depends on the level of the weapon.
scripts.translation:
[蒙斯特]
基本原理之一是，强化道具的成功概率取决于武器的等级。

scripts.text:
[Munster]
For level 1 weapons, you may upgrade up to + 7 without the risk of breaking the weapon. Level 2 weapons can be upgraded to +6. Level 3 weapons can be upgraded to +5 safely.
scripts.translation:
[蒙斯特]
对于1级武器，你可以强化到+7而没有武器损坏的风险。2级武器可以强化到+6。3级武器可以安全地强化到+5。

scripts.text:
[Munster]
For level 4 weapons, you can upgrade + 4 without too much risk. As for armors, you can upgrade them to +4. But if the upgrade for the equipment fails, it will be destroyed!
scripts.translation:
[蒙斯特]
对于4级武器，你可以强化到+4而没有太大风险。至于防具，你可以将它们强化到+4。但如果装备强化失败，它会被破坏的！

scripts.text:
[Munster]
Hmm...
If you get a chance, try to visit my father's workshop here in Al de Baran. If I may say so, he's a pretty talented Blacksmith.
scripts.translation:
[蒙斯特]
嗯...
如果有机会，试着来艾尔帕兰参观我父亲的工作室吧。恕我直言，他是一位非常有天赋的铁匠。

scripts.text:
[Quatro]
Have you heard that a famous Blacksmith moved here from Geffen?
scripts.translation:
[夸特罗]
你听说过一位著名的铁匠从吉芬搬到这里了吗？

scripts.text: Famous Blacksmith?
scripts.translation: 著名的铁匠？

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Quatro]
From what I've heard, he's one of those Blacksmiths that can upgrade your weapons and armor. When you upgrade a weapon, its attack strength is increased.
scripts.translation:
[夸特罗]
据我所知，他是那种可以强化你的武器和防具的铁匠。当你强化武器时，它的攻击力会提升。

scripts.text:
[Quatro]
For each upgrade level, attack strength increases by 2 for level 1 weapons. On level 2 weapons, 3 attack strength is added.
scripts.translation:
[夸特罗]
每提升一个强化等级，1级武器的攻击力增加2点。2级武器增加3点攻击力。

scripts.text:
[Quatro]
On level 3 weapons, 5 attack strength is added for each level, and for level 4 weapons, 7 attack strength is added for each level.
scripts.translation:
[夸特罗]
3级武器每级增加5点攻击力，而4级武器每级增加7点攻击力。

scripts.text:
[Quatro]
This Blacksmith's family lives here, since his wife is sick and weak. Because of her condition, she needs to take medicinal herbs that grow near Al de Baran.
scripts.translation:
[夸特罗]
这位铁匠的家人住在这里，因为他的妻子生病体弱。由于她的病情，她需要服用生长在艾尔帕兰附近的药草。

scripts.text:
[Quatro]
They also have a dutiful son who's always helping out with the family business. I'm sure that kid will grow up to become a good Blacksmith like his father.
scripts.translation:
[夸特罗]
他们还有一个尽职的儿子，总是帮忙打理家业。我相信那孩子长大后会成为像他父亲一样优秀的铁匠。

scripts.text:
[Miller]
Aren't level 4 weapons cool!
I can't believe such powerful
weapons exist!
scripts.translation:
[米勒]
4级武器不是超酷的吗！
真不敢相信竟然存在
这么强大的武器！

scripts.text:
[Miller]
Well, they're rarely seen in the open market, but boss monsters will drop them by a low chance if you happen to be able to kill them.
scripts.translation:
[米勒]
嗯，在公开市场上很少见到它们，但如果你运气好能杀死BOSS，它们会有很低的概率掉落。

scripts.text:
[Joanne]
I enjoy gathering shells from the sea. It's really fun and relaxing~
scripts.translation:
[乔安妮]
我喜欢从海里收集贝壳。这真的很有趣，也很放松~

scripts.text: Shell Gathering?
scripts.translation: 收集贝壳？

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Joanne]
When you see bubbles popping up from the sand or muddy puddles, try digging into the ground a bit. You might find some shells underneath the ground!
scripts.translation:
[乔安妮]
当你看到沙滩或泥泞的水洼中冒出气泡时，试着往地下挖一挖。你可能会在地下发现一些贝壳！

scripts.text:
[Joanne]
Have you heard
of Ambernite?
That shell monster
is pretty tough~
scripts.translation:
[乔安妮]
你听说过
蜗牛吗？
那种壳怪
可是相当强韧的~

scripts.text:
[Joanne]
It's usually seen at the beach near the west province of Prontera. If you ever try attacking it without being prepared, you might be in trouble.
scripts.translation:
[乔安妮]
它们通常出现在普隆德拉西边省份附近的沙滩上。如果你在没有做好准备的情况下贸然攻击它，可能会有麻烦哦。

scripts.text:
[Joanne]
Ambernite is
pretty strong!
So look out for it!
scripts.translation:
[乔安妮]
蜗牛
非常强！
所以要小心它！

scripts.text:
[Joanne]
Ambernite is
pretty strong!
So look out for it!
scripts.translation:
[乔安妮]
蜗牛
非常强！
所以要小心它！

scripts.text:
[Panama]
Al De Baran is known world wide as the City of Canals. The waterways really add a sophisticated, romantic touch to our fair city.
scripts.translation:
[帕纳马]
艾尔帕兰在全世界都以运河之城闻名。水道为我们美丽的城市增添了一抹精致而浪漫的色彩。

scripts.text: About the Canals
scripts.translation: 关于运河

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Panama]
Well, a canal is an artificial waterway used for travel,
shipping, or irrigation.
scripts.translation:
[帕纳马]
嗯，运河是用于旅行、
航运或灌溉的人造水道。

scripts.text:
[Panama]
However, the canals over here are just for show. If we needed to transport anything, we just use the Kafra Corporation Teleport service!
scripts.translation:
[帕纳马]
不过，这里的运河只是为了装饰。如果我们有任何需要运输的东西，直接使用卡普拉公司的瞬间移动服务就行了！

scripts.text:
[Panama]
I have that you will enjoy your stay in Al De Baran.
scripts.translation:
[帕纳马]
我相信你会在艾尔帕兰过得愉快。

scripts.text:
[Isenberg]
Mt. Mjolnir and Payon Forest.
Both of those places are tough
to travel through.
scripts.translation:
[伊森伯格]
雷神之锤山和斐扬树林。
这两个地方都
很难通行。

scripts.text: Mt.Mjolnir?
scripts.translation: 雷神之锤山？

scripts.text: Payon Forest...?
scripts.translation: 斐扬树林...？

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Isenberg]
To arrive here from Prontera or Geffen, you've got to cross the Mjolnir Mountains.
scripts.translation:
[伊森伯格]
若要从普隆德拉或吉芬来到这里，你必须穿过雷神之锤山脉。

scripts.text:
[Isenberg]
If you've made it here by foot without using the Kafra Teleportation service,
then good job!
scripts.translation:
[伊森伯格]
如果你没用卡普拉的瞬间移动服务，而是靠双脚走到这里的，
那干得漂亮！

scripts.text:
[Isenberg]
The Mjolnir Mountains are really steep, and it's full of aggressive and hostile monsters. So it's always a risk to travel through there alone.
scripts.translation:
[伊森伯格]
雷神之锤山脉非常陡峭，而且到处都是具有攻击性的敌对怪物。所以独自在那里旅行总是充满风险。

scripts.text:
[Isenberg]
If you wish to visit Alberta or the city of Payon, you must first travel through the Payon Forest.
scripts.translation:
[伊森伯格]
如果你想去艾尔贝塔或斐扬城，必须先穿过斐扬树林。

scripts.text:
[Isenberg]
The Payon Forest is a winding, intricate maze where it's easy to get lost. Unless you concentrate and keep track of your path, you might be stuck wandering in that dangerous place.
scripts.translation:
[伊森伯格]
斐扬树林是一个蜿蜒曲折、错综复杂的迷宫，很容易迷路。除非你集中注意力并记清自己的路径，否则可能会困在那个危险的地方徘徊。

scripts.text:
[Isenberg]
Payon, the Archer Village, was built deep inside this steep and rugged forest so that it may be protected from outside invaders. So I guess that a good decision on their part.
scripts.translation:
[伊森伯格]
斐扬，也就是弓箭手村，建在这片陡峭崎岖的森林深处，是为了保护它不受外来入侵者的侵害。所以我认为那是他们做出的明智决定。

scripts.text:
[Isenberg]
The huge mountains surrounding this town
blocks people from outside to come into this town.
That may be a part of the reason how we have been able to
keep this beautiful canal and mysterious alchemy
without any influence from outside.
scripts.translation:
[伊森伯格]
环绕这座城镇的巨大山脉
阻挡了外人进入此地。
这或许也是我们能够
在不受外界影响的情况下
保留美丽的运河和神秘炼金术的原因之一。

scripts.text:
[Epthiel]
Some weapons or armor have Slots where you can insert Cards obtained from monsters.
scripts.translation:
[埃普提尔]
某些武器或防具拥有插槽，可以插入从怪物身上获得的卡片。

scripts.text: About the number of Slots
scripts.translation: 关于插槽数量

scripts.text: Relation between Cards and Slots
scripts.translation: 卡片与插槽的关系

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Epthiel]
Items dropped by monsters possess more Slots than ordinary weapons or armor sold in NPC shops.
scripts.translation:
[埃普提尔]
怪物掉落的物品比NPC商店出售的普通武器或防具拥有更多的插槽。

scripts.text:
[Epthiel]
I guess you can assume that an item with more Slots is more valuable than the same item with fewer Slots.
scripts.translation:
[埃普提尔]
我想你可以认为，拥有更多插槽的物品比插槽较少的同类物品更有价值。

scripts.text:
[Epthiel]
Once a Card is inserted into a Slot, it is impossible to remove it. So please be careful when you insert Cards into weapons or armor.
scripts.translation:
[埃普提尔]
一旦卡片被插入插槽，就无法将其取出。所以在将卡片插入武器或防具时请务必小心。

scripts.text:
[Epthiel]
Also, when you mouse over equipment in the Item Window or Vending Window, the name of the item will be followed by the number of its Slots in brackets.
scripts.translation:
[埃普提尔]
此外，当你在物品栏或贩卖窗口中将鼠标悬停在装备上时，物品名称后会用括号标出其插槽数量。

scripts.text:
[Epthiel]
For example, a Shield with 1 Slot, when moused over, would display the name 'Shield [1].'
scripts.translation:
[埃普提尔]
例如，一个拥有1个插槽的盾牌，在鼠标悬停时会显示名称“盾牌 [1]”。

scripts.text:
[Epthiel]
You may also right-click an item, and check the Card Slot window below the item description window for the number of Slots.
scripts.translation:
[埃普提尔]
你也可以右键点击物品，并在物品说明窗口下方的卡片插槽窗口中查看插槽数量。

scripts.text:
[Epithiel]
Have you ever obtained a card from a monster?
scripts.translation:
[埃皮提尔]
你有没有从怪物身上获得过卡片呢？

scripts.text:
[Joy]
Level 1 weapons, which are the lowest grade, need a metal named ^3355FFPhracon^000000 in order to be upgraded.
scripts.translation:
[乔伊]
等级为1的武器是最低等级的，需要一种名为^3355FF强化武器金属-级数一^000000的金属才能进行升级。

scripts.text: About Phracon
scripts.translation: 关于强化武器金属-级数一

scripts.text: Advice about Phracon
scripts.translation: 关于强化武器金属-级数一的建议

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Joy]
Phracon is a pretty common metal and can be found all over the Midgard continent.
scripts.translation:
[乔伊]
强化武器金属-级数一是种相当常见的金属，在整个米德加尔特大陆都能找到。

scripts.text:
[Joy]
Although it lacks the strength of other metals, it's easy to find and obtain. You can get Phracons by killing monsters or by buying them in Forging Shops in towns.
scripts.translation:
[乔伊]
虽然它缺乏其他金属的强度，但很容易被发现和获得。你可以通过击杀怪物或在城镇的锻造铺购买来获得强化武器金属-级数一。

scripts.text:
[Joy]
When you no longer need Phracons because you are using higher level weapons, you can sell them for some zeny!
scripts.translation:
[乔伊]
当你因为使用更高等级的武器而不再需要强化武器金属-级数一时，你可以把它们卖掉换取一些泽尼！

scripts.text:
[Joy]
Well, I hear lots of monsters carry Phracons and will drop them once killed. Why don't you go hunting for them?
scripts.translation:
[乔伊]
嗯，我听说很多怪物都携带强化武器金属-级数一，击杀它们后就会掉落。你为什么不去狩猎它们呢？

scripts.text:
[Joy]
It shouldn't be too difficult. Once I found a Phracon that dropped after killing a Bebe Savage! But if you're desperate, you can always buy them at the Forging Shop.
scripts.translation:
[乔伊]
应该不会太难的。我曾经在击杀一只贝贝野猪后发现过掉落的强化武器金属-级数一！但如果你急需的话，随时可以在锻造铺买到。

scripts.text:
[Joy]
Good luck with finding Phracons!
scripts.translation:
[乔伊]
祝你寻找强化武器金属-级数一时好运！

scripts.text:
[Chemirre]
Alchemists, one of the 2nd Jobs, are able to create items out of several materials using knowledge from the ancient age of Al De Baran.
scripts.translation:
[谢米尔]
炼金术士是二转职业之一，他们能够利用来自艾尔帕兰古代时代的知识，利用多种材料创造出物品。

scripts.text: About Alchemy in Payon
scripts.translation: 关于斐扬的炼金术

scripts.text: Definition of Alchemy
scripts.translation: 炼金术的定义

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Chemirre]
Most people don't know that there was an oriental form of Alchemy that developed in Payon.
scripts.translation:
[谢米尔]
大多数人都不知道，在斐扬曾经发展出过一种东方风格的炼金术。

scripts.text:
[Chemirre]
These Payon Alchemists were able to create Gold out of different materials. However, Payon Alchemy never advanced as much as the Alchemy in Al De Baran.
scripts.translation:
[谢米尔]
这些斐扬的炼金术士能够利用不同的材料制造出黄金。然而，斐扬的炼金术从未像艾尔帕兰的炼金术那样先进。

scripts.text:
[Chemirre]
Materials for Alchemy in Payon were scarce and interest in that field eventually waned. Now, you can only study Alchemy here in Al De Baran.
scripts.translation:
[谢米尔]
由于斐扬的炼金材料稀缺，人们对该领域的兴趣最终也逐渐减退了。现在，你只能在艾尔帕兰学习炼金术。

scripts.text:
[Chemirre]
Still, I can't help but wonder what secrets were lost after the Payon art of Alchemy disappeared from the face of the Earth...
scripts.translation:
[谢米尔]
尽管如此，我还是忍不住在想，当斐扬的炼金术从世界上消失后，究竟丢失了多少秘密……

scripts.text:
[Chemirre]
Alchemists specialize in chemical research in order to create useful items out of various things.
scripts.translation:
[谢米尔]
炼金术士专门从事化学研究，以便利用各种物品制造出有用的道具。

scripts.text:
[Chemirre]
I also hear that they create all sorts of Potions, and can even summon certain monsters! It seems that their studies have all sorts of nifty applications.
scripts.translation:
[谢米尔]
我也听说他们能制造各种各样的药水，甚至能召唤某些怪物！看来他们的研究有着各种各样奇妙的应用。

scripts.text:
[Chemirre]
You are bored, aren't you?
Alright then, I will tell you a story about monster cards and item slots.
As you already know, if you ever have obtained a monster card before,
scripts.translation:
[谢米尔]
你很无聊，对吧？
好吧，那我就给你讲讲关于卡片和插槽的故事吧。
正如你所知，如果你曾经获得过怪物卡片，

scripts.text:
[Chemirre]
you can only insert a monster card to an item
that satisfies the card's location requirement.
For instance, let's say, you have obtained a Poring Card.
scripts.translation:
[谢米尔]
你只能将怪物卡片插入到
符合卡片位置要求的装备中。
例如，假设你获得了一张波利卡片。

scripts.text:
[Chemirre]
When you right click on the card, you will see
its ability as LUK+2 and Perfect Dodge+1
and its location as 'Armor'.
scripts.translation:
[谢米尔]
当你右键点击卡片时，你会看到
它的属性是 LUK+2 和 完美闪避+1
而它的位置是“头饰”。

scripts.text:
[Chemirre]
If you try to insert this card to a dagger with many slots,
it is not going to work because the card only can be inserted to
armor items.
scripts.translation:
[谢米尔]
如果你尝试将这张卡片插入一把带有多个插槽的匕首，
那是行不通的，因为这张卡片只能插入到
防具类装备中。

scripts.text:
[Chemirre]
Almost every armor items that are being sold
in town shops do not have slots on them.
That means, you can only obtain
slotted armors by hunting monsters.
scripts.translation:
[谢米尔]
城镇商店里出售的几乎所有防具
都没有插槽。
这意味着，你只能通过狩猎怪物
来获得带有插槽的防具。

scripts.text:
[Chemirre]
Ah, let me tell you how you can insert a card to an item.
If you want to insert a card on your equipped armor,
you must unequip the armor first.
And then, double click a card that you want to use.
Then a list of armor, that you can insert the card, will be displayed.
scripts.translation:
[谢米尔]
啊，让我告诉你如何将卡片插入装备。
如果你想将卡片插入已装备的防具，
你必须先脱下该防具。
然后，双击你想要使用的卡片。
接着，系统会显示出可以插入该卡片的防具列表。

scripts.text:
[Chemirre]
It is not that complicated, is it?
scripts.translation:
[谢米尔]
这并不复杂，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Chemirre]
You can talk about Rune-Midgarts' alchemy
without talking about the Al De Baran Alchemist Guild!
Long Live Alchemists!
scripts.translation:
[谢米尔]
如果不谈论艾尔帕兰的炼金术士公会，
就无法谈论卢恩·米德加兹的炼金术！
炼金术士万岁！

scripts.text:
[Bebe]
A while ago I went out for a walk toward Mt. Mjolnir with my pet Savage Bebe. His name is NukNuk!
We got attacked, but luckily we weren't hurt.
scripts.translation:
[贝贝]
不久前，我带着我的宠物野猪贝贝去雷神之锤山散步。他的名字叫NukNuk！
我们遭到了攻击，但幸好我们没有受伤。

scripts.text: Attacked?
scripts.translation: 遭到了攻击？

scripts.text: About Mt.Mjolnir
scripts.translation: 关于雷神之锤山

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Bebe]
I was walking up a narrow path, and out of the blue, a giant and ugly plant started to attack me and NukNuk!
scripts.translation:
[贝贝]
我当时正走在一条狭窄的小路上，突然间，一株巨大且丑陋的植物开始攻击我和NukNuk！

scripts.text:
[Bebe]
I was so surprised, so me and NukNuk had to run away. I threw rocks at it, but I don't think I hurt it. It must have been really strong!
scripts.translation:
[贝贝]
我吓坏了，于是我和NukNuk只能逃跑。我向它扔了石头，但我觉得并没有伤到它。它一定非常强壮！

scripts.text:
[Bebe]
What really surprised me was the plant that attacked me was a huge flower with the face of a person! So, look out for those. They're dangerous!
scripts.translation:
[贝贝]
最让我惊讶的是，攻击我的植物竟然是一朵长着人脸的巨大花儿！所以，一定要小心那些家伙。它们很危险！

scripts.text:
[Bebe]
Even though people are fascinated by the scenic beauty of Mt. Mjolnir, it's full of dangerous monsters!
scripts.translation:
[贝贝]
虽然人们都被雷神之锤山的壮丽景色所吸引，但那里到处都是危险的怪物！

scripts.text:
[Bebe]
There are Flowers, Insects, Bees, Butterflies and Moths that are big enough to kill you if you're not careful!
scripts.translation:
[贝贝]
那里有花儿、昆虫、蜜蜂、蝴蝶和飞蛾，如果不小心的话，它们大到足以要了你的命！

scripts.text:
[Bebe]
Then again, most of these monsters won't hurt you if you don't attack first. But some of them will attack you once they see you!
scripts.translation:
[贝贝]
不过话又说回来，如果你不先攻击它们，大多数怪物是不会伤害你的。但有些怪物一旦看到你就会发起攻击！

scripts.text:
[Bebe]
By the way, where is my NukNuk...?
NukNuk! Come out!
scripts.translation:
[贝贝]
对了，我的NukNuk在哪儿……？
NukNuk！快出来！

scripts.text:
[Stromme]
Even to a strong Swordman, the Insects or Mt. Mjolnir pose a considerable threat. You've got to know your enemy before engaging it in battle!
scripts.translation:
[斯特罗姆]
即使是对强大的剑士来说，昆虫或雷神之锤山也构成了相当大的威胁。在战斗之前，你必须了解你的敌人！

scripts.text: About Insects
scripts.translation: 关于昆虫

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Stromme]
Honey Bees, Butterflies and Moths seem like simple creatures, but that doesn't mean you should underestimate them.
scripts.translation:
[斯特罗姆]
蜜蜂、蝴蝶和飞蛾看起来像是简单的生物，但这并不意味着你应该低估它们。

scripts.text:
[Stromme]
These Insects have evolved over time, and can counter attacks from threats like you adventurers!
scripts.translation:
[斯特罗姆]
这些昆虫随着时间的推移而进化，能够反击像你们冒险者这样的威胁！

scripts.text:
[Stromme]
There are also carnivorous Insects, such as praying Spiders, praying Mantises, and the millipede like Argiopes.
scripts.translation:
[斯特罗姆]
还有一些食肉昆虫，比如祈祷蜘蛛、螳螂，以及像艾吉欧蜈蚣那样的多足类生物。

scripts.text:
[Stromme]
These monsters have mutated and are too strong for a person at certain levels. You should especially watch out for Argiopes.
scripts.translation:
[斯特罗姆]
这些怪物发生了变异，对于某些等级的人来说太强大了。你应该特别小心艾吉欧蜈蚣。

scripts.text:
[Stromme]
Luckily, their eyesight is pretty bad, so it won't notice you if you walk a safe distance away from it.
scripts.translation:
[斯特罗姆]
幸运的是，它们的视力很差，所以如果你保持一段安全的距离走开，它们就不会注意到你。

scripts.text:
[Stromme]
No matter how harmless and pretty insects are,
take heed to not touch them.
They are extremely strong unlike their innocent looking.
Don't belittle the livings in the Mt. Mjolnir.
scripts.translation:
[斯特罗姆]
无论昆虫看起来多么无害和漂亮，
都要留心不要去碰它们。
它们并不像外表看起来那么温顺，其实非常强壮。
不要小看雷神之锤山上的生物。

scripts.text:
[Sylvia]
I came all the way here from Prontera because I heard the Kafra Main Office was somewhere here in Al De Baran.
scripts.translation:
[西尔维娅]
我特地从普隆德拉赶到这里，因为我听说卡普拉总公司就在艾尔帕兰附近的某个地方。

scripts.text:
[Sylvia]
It shouldn't be that hard to find, but I'm awful at following directions. I always get lost, no matter how hard I try!
scripts.translation:
[西尔维娅]
按理说应该不难找，但我非常不擅长看方向。无论我怎么努力，总是会迷路！

scripts.text:
[Sylvia]
If that wasn't bad enough, I left my Magnifiers back in Prontera, so now I have to find someone to help me with these weapons I've got to appraise!
scripts.translation:
[西尔维娅]
如果这还不算糟糕的话，我把放大镜都落在普隆德拉了，所以现在我得找个人帮我鉴定这些武器！

scripts.text: Appraise?
scripts.translation: 鉴定？

scripts.text: That's very nice.
scripts.translation: 那太好了。

scripts.text:
[Sylvia]
Equipment that is dropped by monsters can't be equipped right away.
scripts.translation:
[西尔维娅]
怪物掉落的装备不能立即装备。

scripts.text:
[Sylvia]
If you right-click the equippable item in the Item Inventory, you'll see that it is Unidentified and that Appraisal is needed. What to do?
scripts.translation:
[西尔维娅]
如果你在物品栏中右键点击可装备的物品，你会看到它是未鉴定的，需要进行鉴定。该怎么办呢？

scripts.text:
[Sylvia]
Well, in that case, you've gotta use ^3355FF Magnifier^000000!
scripts.translation:
[西尔维娅]
既然如此，那你必须使用 ^3355FF 放大镜^000000！

scripts.text:
[Sylvia]
Even without a Blacksmith, Alchemist or Merchant in your party, you can appraise your equipment! Of course, a Magnifier is consumed each time you use one...
scripts.translation:
[西尔维娅]
即使你的队伍里没有铁匠、炼金术士或商人，你也可以鉴定装备！当然，每次使用都会消耗一个放大镜……

scripts.text:
[Sylvia]
Hey...
Was that a hint of sarcasm in your voice when you said that?
scripts.translation:
[西尔维娅]
喂……
你刚才说话的时候，语气里是不是带着讽刺？

scripts.text:
[Issei]
Al De Baran is such a wonderful place with its romantic canals and classic architecture. I love nothing more than to stroll through this city with my beautiful girlfriend.
scripts.translation:
[一诚]
艾尔帕兰是个多么美好的地方啊，浪漫的运河和古典的建筑。没有什么比和漂亮的女朋友一起漫步在这座城市更让我开心的了。

scripts.text: You have a girlfriend?
scripts.translation: 你有女朋友？

scripts.text: End Conversation.
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Issei]
Hey...
Is that so hard to believe?! Yeah, ask anyone! She really exists! Although, sometimes, just sometimes mind you, she gets too excited about weapons and armor.
scripts.translation:
[一诚]
喂……
这很难相信吗？！没错，去问问任何人吧！她真的存在！虽然，有时候，我强调一下，只是有时候，她会对武器和防具表现得过于兴奋。

scripts.text:
[Issei]
I mean, instead of enjoying a romantic dinner, she'll just go on about how equipment dropped from monsters is higher quality than those sold in shops...
scripts.translation:
[一诚]
我的意思是，她不去享受浪漫的晚餐，反而一直念叨着怪物掉落的装备比商店卖的质量更高……

scripts.text:
[Issei]
I mean, why should I care if equipment dropped by monsters tend to have more Slots?! I can't even kill a Poring!
scripts.translation:
[一诚]
我的意思是，为什么我要在意怪物掉落的装备往往有更多插槽呢？！我连一只波利都杀不了！

scripts.text:
[Issei]
As you can see,
I'm a lover,
 not a fighter.
scripts.translation:
[一诚]
如你所见，
我是一个浪漫主义者，
而不是战士。

scripts.text:
[Issei]
So, you don't think of me stupid, do you?
scripts.translation:
[一诚]
所以，你不会觉得我傻吧？

scripts.text:
[Joo Jahk]
I'm a tourist
from Payon,
the City of Forests.
scripts.translation:
[朱雀]
我是来自
斐扬的游客，
那座森林之城。

scripts.text:
[Joo Jahk]
The tempature here in Al De Baran is very cool, probably because of the waterways. Do you think the water in the canals is drinkable?
scripts.translation:
[朱雀]
艾尔帕兰这里的温度非常凉爽，可能是因为水路的原因。你觉得运河里的水可以喝吗？

scripts.text:
[Joo Jahk]
Well, it's too late for me, since I already drank some. Still, I'm a little worried...
scripts.translation:
[朱雀]
好吧，对我来说已经太晚了，因为我已经喝了一些。不过，我还是有点担心……

scripts.text: Continue.
scripts.translation: 继续。

scripts.text: End conversation.
scripts.translation: 结束对话。

scripts.text:
[Joo Jahk]
On one of my travels around Midgard, I've heard from a really high level Mage that physical attacks, or magic with Neutral Property, won't damage Spiritual Property monsters.
scripts.translation:
[朱雀]
在我游历米德加尔特的旅途中，我听一位等级非常高的魔法师说过，物理攻击或中属性魔法是无法对灵属性怪物造成伤害的。

scripts.text:
[Joo Jahk]
Maybe that advice will come in handy, now that you know that. Always remember the importance of the Properties of your skills and weapons when battling monsters.
scripts.translation:
[朱雀]
既然你已经知道了，也许这个建议会派上用场。在与怪物战斗时，请务必记住技能和武器属性的重要性。

scripts.text:
[Joo Jahk]
On the other hand, the water I drank did taste pretty good. Hopefully it didn't have anything too weird in it...
scripts.translation:
[朱雀]
另一方面，我喝的水尝起来确实挺好喝的。希望里面没有掺杂什么奇怪的东西……

scripts.text:
[Gavin]
Welcome!
The town of
Al De Baran
welcomes you!
scripts.translation:
[加文]
欢迎！
艾尔帕兰
小镇欢迎你！

scripts.text:
[Gavin]
Well, that might be an exaggeration. After all, it's just me that's welcoming you.
Hey there!
scripts.translation:
[加文]
好吧，那可能有点夸张了。毕竟，只有我一个人在欢迎你。
嘿，你好！

scripts.text: Now, tell me about monsters.
scripts.translation: 现在，跟我讲讲关于怪物的事吧。

scripts.text: End conversation.
scripts.translation: 结束对话。

scripts.text:
[Gavin]
Monsters...?
Aren't we straying off topic a little bit? Ah, you must be one of those adventurers!
scripts.translation:
[加文]
怪物...？
我们是不是有点离题了？啊，你一定是那些冒险者之一！

scripts.text:
[Gavin]
Can't get your mind off the job, eh? Alright, now there was some monster that I saw just recently...
scripts.translation:
[加文]
脑子里全是工作，对吧？好吧，我最近确实看到了一些怪物...

scripts.text:
[Gavin]
Ah, now I remember! Just a few days ago, I saw a really interesting looking monster! It was a Poring with Angel's wings!
scripts.translation:
[加文]
啊，我想起来了！就在几天前，我看到了一只长得非常有趣的怪物！那是一只长着天使翅膀的波利！

scripts.text:
[Gavin]
I swear! He was jumping around somewhere near Mt. Mjolnir with some ordinary Porings. I think he was, like, their leader.
scripts.translation:
[加文]
我发誓！他当时就在雷神之锤山附近，和一些普通的波利一起到处跳来跳去。我觉得他就像是他们的领袖一样。

scripts.text:
[Gavin]
Awww...
Don't be too disappointed that there's only one person in your welcome wagon!
scripts.translation:
[加文]
Awww...
别因为欢迎队伍里只有一个人就太失望啦！

scripts.text:
[Nastasia]
Somewhere in the world there is an ^3355FFAssassin Guild^000000, where they teach people the subtle art of assassination.
scripts.translation:
[娜斯塔西娅]
在这个世界的某个地方，存在着一个^3355FFAssassin Guild^000000，在那里他们教授人们精妙的暗杀艺术。

scripts.text:
[Nastasia]
But isn't killing illegal? And do they even collect educational tuition?
scripts.translation:
[娜斯塔西娅]
但是杀人不是违法的吗？而且他们真的会收取学费吗？

scripts.text: Continue conversation.
scripts.translation: 继续交谈

scripts.text: End Conversation.
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Nastasia]
Although Assassins benefit from being very quick and having lots of AGI, they should still have some DEX.
scripts.translation:
[娜斯塔西娅]
虽然刺客受益于极快的速度和高敏捷，但他们仍然需要一定的命中。

scripts.text:
[Nastasia]
DEX is especially important if you want to hit monsters with wings. Those monsters are quick moving and fast in attacking.
scripts.translation:
[娜斯塔西娅]
如果你想击中那些长着翅膀的怪物，命中尤为重要。那些怪物移动速度很快，攻击也很快。

scripts.text:
[Nastasia]
In general, if you want to hit monsters that are as fast, or even faster, than you are, you're going to need some DEX.
scripts.translation:
[娜斯塔西娅]
总的来说，如果你想击中那些和你一样快、甚至比你还要快的怪物，你就需要一定的命中。

scripts.text:
[Nastasia]
It's usually said that in this world, nothing is free. Still, if you don't have to pay money to learn to be an Assassin...
scripts.translation:
[娜斯塔西娅]
人们常说，这个世界上没有免费的东西。不过，如果你不需要花钱就能学会成为一名刺客的话...

scripts.text:
[Bell Keeper]
I have been charged by the Committee of 'Heaven on Earth' to guard this entrance of the Clock Tower.
scripts.translation:
[守钟人]
我受“人间天堂”委员会的委托，负责守卫钟楼的入口。

scripts.text: About Clock Tower.
scripts.translation: 关于钟楼

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Bell Keeper]
Every floor of this tower is connected to each other by a certain device we like to call 'Warp Gear.'
scripts.translation:
[守钟人]
这座塔的每一层都通过一种我们称之为“传送装置”的设备相互连接。

scripts.text:
[Bell Keeper]
Even though there are interconnecting warps everywhere in the Clock Tower, beware the 'Random Warp.'
scripts.translation:
[守钟人]
虽然钟楼各处都有相互连接的传送点，但要当心“随机传送”。

scripts.text:
[Bell Keeper]
The 'Random Warp' will transport you to an unknown spot. Be advised if you don't want to suddenly be separated from your party...
scripts.translation:
[守钟人]
“随机传送”会将你传送到一个未知的地方。如果你不想突然与你的队伍分离，请务必小心...

scripts.text:
[Bell Keeper]
Remember, Random Warps are shown in green on the mini-map. So keep your eyes peeled for that, as well as for those dangerous Clocks.
scripts.translation:
[守钟人]
记住，随机传送在小地图上显示为绿色。所以请密切留意，也要留意那些危险的古钟魔。

scripts.text:
[Bell Keeper]
Please take heed that this Clock Tower is filled with extremely dangerous monsters.
scripts.translation:
[守钟人]
请务必小心，这座钟楼里充满了极其危险的怪物。

scripts.text:
[RS125]
I may sound inhuman rather robotic
however, I hope you will not be afraid of me. I am as humane as you are.
scripts.translation:
[RS125]
我的声音听起来可能不像人类，反而像机器人，
但我希望你不要害怕我。我和你一样拥有人性。

scripts.text:
[RS125]
I may have a machine heart and I may disturb you with loud noises from the heart,
that will never stop me from running for future of Al De Baran.
scripts.translation:
[RS125]
我可能拥有一颗机械之心，也可能因为心脏发出的巨大噪音而干扰到你，
但这永远不会阻止我为艾尔帕兰的未来而奔跑。

scripts.text: Listen to his story.
scripts.translation: 听他的故事。

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[RS125]
It's been 3 years already.
My brother 996 used to be a short track athlete in the Al De Baran city field team.
Back then, people gave him a nickname, 'Al De Baran's Peco Peco',
for his amazingly fast legs...
scripts.translation:
[RS125]
已经过去3年了。
我的哥哥996曾是艾尔帕兰市田径队的短跑运动员。
那时候，人们因为他那惊人的速度，
给他起了一个绰号，叫作“艾尔帕兰的大嘴鸟”……

scripts.text:
[RS125]
He became so popular for his exciting play,
so every time when the 'Al De Baran Turbo Track' was held once every 4 years,
many people from all over the continent came to this city only to see my brother.
I was his manager at the time and I was so stressed out because of his fans.
scripts.translation:
[RS125]
他因为精彩的表现而变得非常受欢迎，
所以每当四年一度的“艾尔帕兰涡轮赛道”比赛举行时，
来自整个大陆的许多人都会专门来到这座城市，只为见我哥哥一面。
我当时是他的经纪人，因为他的粉丝们，我压力大得不得了。

scripts.text:
[RS125]
However, there is nothing last forever...
One day, a girl from Payon beat my brother from a game.
scripts.translation:
[RS125]
然而，没有什么事能永恒不变……
有一天，一个来自斐扬的女孩在比赛中击败了我哥哥。

scripts.text:
[RS125]
My brother couldn't accept the fact that he lost the game
so he did too much of practice and had a serious heart attack.
He is still in bed.
scripts.translation:
[RS125]
我哥哥无法接受输掉比赛的事实，
于是他进行了过度的训练，导致了严重的心脏病发作。
他现在还卧病在床。

scripts.text:
[RS125]
I am my brother's only hope and the future of Al De Baran!
Please wish me luck, I will beat her, 'Breezy Havana' from Payon!
scripts.translation:
[RS125]
我是我哥哥唯一的希望，也是艾尔帕兰的未来！
请祝我好运吧，我一定会击败来自斐扬的“微风哈瓦那”！

scripts.text:
[RS125]
I want to travel around the world one of these days.
If I can see the ocean from the port of Alberta, it must be so wonderful.
After the next year's athletic competition, I will go on a round-the-world tour with my brother.
scripts.translation:
[RS125]
总有一天我想环游世界。
如果能在艾尔贝塔的港口看到大海，那一定很美妙。
明年的运动会结束后，我要和哥哥一起去环球旅行。

scripts.text:
[Threatening-Looking Man]
Hey, you don't come inside someone else's house without permission.
This is ridiculous!
How dare you to come inside of my house and talk to me as if that is a normal thing to do?
scripts.translation:
[面相凶恶的男子]
喂，没经过允许不准随便进别人的家。
这太荒谬了！
你竟敢闯进我家，还一副理所当然的样子跟我说话？

scripts.text:
[Threatening-Looking Man]
Hahahaha...chill out, I was just joking.
scripts.translation:
[面相凶恶的男子]
哈哈哈哈……冷静点，我开玩笑的。

scripts.text: Continue
scripts.translation: 继续

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Threatening-Looking Man]
You may know this already, but
we have a system called, the mercenary system in this world.
Yes, I am a mercenary soldier.
scripts.translation:
[面相凶恶的男子]
你可能已经知道了，
在这个世界上，我们有一种被称为“雇佣兵系统”的制度。
没错，我就是一名雇佣兵。

scripts.text:
[Threatening-Looking Man]
It is simple. You just pay for someone to aid you in fight.
Better mercenary soldier you want, more money you have to pay, you know?
scripts.translation:
[面相凶恶的男子]
很简单。你只需要付钱请人协助你战斗。
想要更厉害的雇佣兵，就得付更多的钱，你懂吧？

scripts.text:
[Threatening-Looking Man]
Let's stop talking about boring stuffs.
I will tell you how you can find a good mercenary soldier.
scripts.translation:
[面相凶恶的男子]
别聊这些无聊的事了。
我会告诉你该如何寻找优秀的雇佣兵。

scripts.text:
[Threatening-Looking Man]
Check its nose if it is clean and wet.
A good mercenary soldier must have the wet nose
because it shows that the soldier is at his best in health condition.
If the nose is dry, that means that he caught a cold.
scripts.translation:
[面相凶恶的男子]
检查一下他的鼻子是不是干净且湿润的。
优秀的雇佣兵必须拥有湿润的鼻子，
因为这代表该士兵正处于最佳的健康状态。
如果鼻子是干的，那就意味着他感冒了。

scripts.text:
[Threatening-Looking Man]
And don't forget to check the soldier's ankle.
The best mercenary soldier has thin ankles and a white neck!
If he has long hair, it's better! If the hair is permed and wavy, that's perfect!
scripts.translation:
[面相凶恶的男子]
别忘了检查士兵的脚踝。
最顶尖的雇佣兵拥有纤细的脚踝和白皙的脖子！
如果他留着长发就更好了！如果头发是烫过的卷发，那就完美了！

scripts.text:
[Threatening-Looking Man]
Lastly, you have to check whether he is ready to serve you with quality service!

scripts.translation:

Kafra Corporation.

always here to serve you.

[卡普拉 布洛森]
欢迎来到
卡普拉公司。
卡普拉服务员
随时为您服务。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Blossom]
We appreciate your continued use of the Kafra Service. Please feel free to ask me if you have any questions.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 布洛森]
感谢您一直以来对卡普拉服务的支持。如果您有任何问题，请随时询问我。

scripts.text: How does Kafra Storage work?
scripts.translation: 卡普拉仓库是如何运作的？

scripts.text: How do you teleport people?
scripts.translation: 你们是怎么传送人的？

scripts.text:
[Kafra Blossom]
Well, adventurers like yourself can place items into Kafra Storage, so that you don't have to carry all of your stuff around.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 布洛森]
嗯，像您这样的冒险者可以将物品放入卡普拉仓库，这样您就不必随身携带所有的东西了。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Blossom]
Now, the Kafra Storage Window is separated into three tabs into which items are automatically sorted.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 布洛森]
现在，卡普拉仓库窗口分为三个标签页，物品会自动进行分类。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Blossom]
The ^3355FFItem^000000, ^3355FFEquip^000000, and ^3355FFEtc^000000 tabs work just like the tabs in your character Item Inventory.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 布洛森]
^3355FF物品^000000、^3355FF装备^000000 和 ^3355FF杂物^000000 标签页的功能与您角色物品栏中的标签页完全相同。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Blossom]
Multiple items of the same type will only take up one Slot in the Item and Etc. tabs. For example, 324 Jellopies would take up only one Slot, and 22 Red Potions would take another Slot.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 布洛森]
在物品和杂物标签页中，同类型的多个物品只会占用一个格子。例如，324 个果冻只会占用一个格子，而 22 瓶红色药水会占用另一个格子。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Blossom]
However, in the Equip tab, each and every single item takes up its own Slot. I guess that's because each and every single equipment can be uniquely upgraded by forging or through Cards.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 布洛森]
但在装备标签页中，每一件物品都会占用自己的格子。我想这是因为每一件装备都可以通过锻造或卡片进行独特的强化。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Blossom]
There's a total of 300 Slots for all three item categories in the Kafra Storage, so it might be helpful to remember that.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 布洛森]
卡普拉仓库中所有三个物品类别的总容量为 300 个格子，记住这一点可能会对您有所帮助。

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

此外，单凭卡普拉女孩们是无法传送客户的。我们只是接收并处理您的传送请求。

scripts.text:

Behind the scenes, skilled professionals and technicians are working 24 hours a day to ensure that you teleport quickly and safely to your destination.
scripts.translation:

感谢您远道而来，造访我们位于艾尔帕兰的卡普拉公司总部！

scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 贾丝敏]
太棒了！

scripts.text:

The Kafra Corporation will always support Midgard's adventurers with our excellent services.

卡普拉公司将始终以卓越的服务支持米德加尔特的冒险者们。

scripts.text: Kafra Policies
scripts.translation: 卡普拉政策

scripts.text: I love Kafra!
scripts.translation: 我爱卡普拉！

scripts.text:
[Kafra Roxie]
So, you'd like more details on our policies and eligibility for our services? What would you like me to explain?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 洛克茜]
那么，您是想了解更多关于我们的政策以及服务资格的详情吗？您想让我解释哪方面的内容呢？

scripts.text: Kafra Storage
scripts.translation: 卡普拉仓库

scripts.text: Cart Rental
scripts.translation: 手推车租赁

scripts.text: Actually, never mind.
scripts.translation: 其实，还是算了。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Roxie]
As you probably already know, our customers must have at least Basic Skill level 6 in order to use the Kafra Storage.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 洛克茜]
正如您可能已经知道的那样，我们的客户必须至少拥有 6 级的 Basic Skill 才能使用卡普拉仓库。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Roxie]
As for the reason for this certain policy, we've had problems with young, fresh faced Novices that would put everything into their Storage.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 洛克茜]
至于这项特定政策的原因，是因为我们遇到过一些年轻、稚嫩的初心者，他们会把所有东西都放进仓库里。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Roxie]
Now you remember your days as a Novice. Everything was new and exciting, but zeny was scarce. Well, a lot of Novices would even put their weapons and armor in Kafra Storage.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 洛克茜]
您一定还记得您作为初心者的日子。一切都是那么新鲜有趣，但泽尼却很匮乏。很多初心者甚至会把武器和防具都放进卡普拉仓库里。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Roxie]
However, by this time, they've already spent what little zeny they had to open their Storage. But they don't have enough to access their Storage again!
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 洛克茜]
然而，到了那个时候，他们已经花光了仅有的那点泽尼来开启仓库。结果他们就没有足够的钱再次开启仓库了！

scripts.text:
[Kafra Roxie]
So, these weaponless, armorless Novices must fight monsters with their bare hands until they gather the zeny to open their Kafra Storage again!
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 洛克茜]
于是，这些既没武器也没防具的初心者只能徒手与怪物搏斗，直到他们攒够了再次开启卡普拉仓库所需的泽尼！

scripts.text:
[Kafra Roxie]
It's a silly mistake, to be sure, but we here at Kafra Corporation value human life, and decided on the Basic Skill Level 6 Requirement to prevent this kind of mishap.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 洛克茜]
这确实是个愚蠢的错误，但我们卡普拉公司非常重视生命，因此决定设立 Basic Skill 6 级的要求，以防止这类意外发生。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Roxie]
As you may know, the Kafra Corporation has a special relationship with the Merchant Guild, as well as the Blacksmith and Alchemist guilds in Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 洛克茜]
如您所知，卡普拉公司与商人公会，以及米德加尔特的铁匠公会和炼金术士公会都有着特殊的合作关系。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Roxie]
The Kafra Corporation only rents Carts to Merchants, Blacksmiths and Alchemists since these job associations have a special contract with us.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 洛克茜]
卡普拉公司仅向商人、铁匠和炼金术士租赁手推车，因为这些职业协会与我们签有特殊合同。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Roxie]
Also, it'd be really impractical to rent carts out to people who couldn't create or sell goods.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 洛克茜]
此外，如果把手推车租给那些无法制造或销售货物的人，也会非常不切实际。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Roxie]
As for Super Novices, well, we're really not supposed to rent carts to them since the Super Novice Society in Al De Baran doesn't have a contract with us.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 洛克茜]
至于超级初心者，嗯，我们确实不应该向他们租赁手推车，因为艾尔帕兰的超级初心者协会并没有与我们签订合同。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Roxie]
If a Kafra Employee rented a Cart to a Super Novice, she'd probably get in big trouble with Leilah...
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 洛克茜]
如果卡普拉服务员把手推车租给超级初心者，她可能会因为这件事被莱拉狠狠教训一顿吧……
